g.title: TF_PROFILE_CATALOG
g.text: When turned off, users in this profile who are also eligible to use the Proxy feature can impersonate any active user. When turned on, users in this profile who are also eligible to use the Proxy feature can only impersonate active users included in the specified set
A set used to limit the list of users that is possible to impersonate using the proxy logon feature.
This profile is exclude from automatical assignment of default profiles.
